description: This file defines the ReminderRepository class, which provides an abstraction layer over ReminderDao to perform CRUD operations on Reminder data objects, including retrieval, insertion, updating, deletion, and copying reminders, primarily using reactive Flow streams.

classes.name: ReminderRepository
classes.description: Repository class that manages Reminder data operations by delegating to ReminderDao, facilitating data access with Kotlin Flow and suspend functions.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream of all Reminder objects.

methods.name: getByNoteId
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream of Reminders associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream containing a single Reminder or null if not found, based on reminder ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Reminder into the database and returns its generated ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates one or more Reminder objects in the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a Reminder from the database by its ID.

methods.name: deleteByNoteId
methods.description: Deletes all Reminders associated with a specific note ID.

methods.name: copyReminders
methods.description: Copies Reminders from one note ID to another.
